reason: FOCAL is a local task-memory plugin that filters session activity into bounded task-isolated memories and optionally injects the active task context into subsequent model requests.

summaries.zh: FOCAL 是一个本地任务记忆插件，可将会话活动筛选为按任务隔离的有限记忆，并按配置将当前任务上下文注入后续模型请求。
summaries.en: FOCAL is a local task-memory plugin that filters session activity into bounded task-isolated memories and optionally injects active-task context into later model requests.

capabilities: Observes committed session and event records
Stores selected user text, tool metadata, and path-like arguments with configured bounds
Provides read-only status and recall tools
Injects filtered active-task context into later model requests when enabled
Supports human-triggered deletion of task or all stored memories
